Asha (PM): Short sync: pick default network mode for GA. Field wants both low-touch and IP-preserve options. Decision needed by Friday.
Ben (Eng): Tech tradeoffs: default relay keeps install <10m, less support. preserve gives stable source IPs but needs peering/BGP and preflight.
Ruth (Solutions): Customer profiles: regulated customers need preserve; most SMBs prefer relay. Recommend relay default + preserve opt-in.
Tao (SRE): Ops: add SLIs for egress_p95 and bgp_flaps. Preserve should be gated behind operator >=1.3.0 and a 2h maintenance window declaration.
Ben (Eng): Upgrade path when enabling preserve: preflight -> dry-run peering -> 10m traffic mirror -> cutover with rollback. We'll provide CLI preflight flags.
Asha (PM): Action list: Ben: preflight spec + CLI examples (3d). Ruth: field checklist + firewall text (2d). Tao: SLIs + alerts (5d). I'll draft decision rubric for GTM.
sysbot: Reminder set: "priv-network-mode-decision" 2024-07-12 09:00 UTC.
Asha (PM): Locking this as the decision snapshot. Update if specs change.
